lede: Houston Texans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#23 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tennessee Titans +6.4 with a fair total of 39.9 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs Houston Texans pass defence, which sits −0.336 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
